candidate_state_transaction.accepted: seal CandidateState as State_k+1 and consume exactly bound evidence IDs
candidate_state_transaction.compose: compose all carrier outcomes into one CandidateState_k_plus_1; unchanged carriers point to State_k artifacts
candidate_state_transaction.generation: all carrier candidates for round k are generated from the same accepted State_k, preserving current parallel-carrier causal semantics
candidate_state_transaction.no_candidate_change: seal accounting round with State_k unchanged and no acceptance probe

promotion_rule.strict_task_improvement_required: at least one of exact_success, positive_score, or mean_score is strictly greater

candidate_state_transaction.rejected: retain immutable candidate artifacts/receipt; active next state remains State_k; mark bound evidence attempted/rejected for identical method revision

agent_system.candidate_generation: existing OpenEVO reflector only if it independently returns UPDATE
agent_system.global_policy_noise_guard: no promotion without state-level causal acceptance

sd_lora.eligible_online_evidence: clean exact-success whole trajectories only in v1
sd_lora.max_records_256_role: optimizer/resource capacity cap only; never a success gate
sd_lora.reason: C step-level causal microtest changed behavior but demonstrated zero reward benefit
sd_lora.selector: preserve current clean exact-success / distinct-task selector semantics for v1; same-task multiplicity expansion requires a later amendment

skill_bundle.candidate_generation: existing OpenEVO reflector, with typed transition evidence and prior skill

text_memory.candidate_generation: existing OpenEVO reflector, but input is typed ledger evidence rather than treating whole failures as correct answers

forbidden: gate=8 or any task-count magic gate
256-rollout parametric cadence as a scientific gate
clear evidence because a 128-rollout round ended
whole partial trajectory SFT from reward>=0.5
verified partial steps into SD-LoRA v1
final-panel access before own Stage2 seal
post-hoc modification of promotion rule after formal outcomes
name: OpenEVO-Ceiling-1.0 3B Stage2-vNext persistent evidence + candidate-state acceptance
next_gate: Implement this exact Stage2-vNext design + CPU/static tests + launch-readiness. No additional pre-Stage2 scientific experiment.
scientific_question: Can 3B sustain Stage2 learning when observation rounds no longer reset evidence, deterministic partial evidence is routed conservatively, and any changed candidate state must demonstrate fixed causal task benefit before promotion?

consumption.accepted_candidate: only evidence IDs explicitly bound to accepted updates become consumed
consumption.noop: no evidence is consumed or cleared
consumption.rejected_candidate: retain immutable evidence but mark attempted/rejected for the same prior-state+method-revision; do not repeat the identical candidate without new evidence

labels.unknown: never promoted to supervision merely because it appears plausible
